provenance: Author repositories identify their winning NIPS2017 branches and the momentum paper cited in the version-bound intake. The restored intake has no explicit repository reference field; correspondence is supported by named paper and detailed algorithm/entrypoint matches, not an invented catalog URL.

non_targeted.labels: First-iteration argmax of unweighted summed probability predictions, then frozen; not majority vote or weighted-logit argmax.
non_targeted.update: Mean-absolute gradient normalization; momentum accumulation; add alpha*sign; project into fixed original epsilon box and[-1,1]. Alpha=(2*epsilon/255)/iterations.

targeted_shared: Caller target labels; main+0.4aux cross-entropy. Divide raw gradients by per-example population standard deviation, accumulate momentum, divide accumulated value by its standard deviation, subtract alpha*clip(round(noise),-2,2), then project. No epsilon denominator stabilizer in the source.
closure_requirements: Preserve both targeted regimes and the separate non-targeted branch; adaptive epsilon strategy is not universal.
Pin/reproduce TensorFlow Slim InceptionV3/V4/InceptionResNetV2/ResNetV2-101 main and auxiliary endpoints with explicit state policy; no external pretrained downloads.
Source tensors use299x299 RGB scaled[-1,1],1001 classes, fixed batch10 with zero-padded tail. Preserve or explicitly adapt file/PNG quantization and tail semantics.
Characterize zero-gradient/zero-variance division, rounding ties, clipping, frozen labels and loss reduction with source comparisons and independent synthetic oracles.
Validate iterative updates, full model execution, serialized graph, automated Tier3 semantic review and served publication before marking covered.
limits: Source/software/license review only; no numerical implementation, TensorFlow compatibility or promotion claim. No images, class-label files or weights fetched.
